text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. Developers often refactor to make their code easier to read and understand. This is important because clear code is simpler to maintain and update in the future. Refactoring also helps reduce technical debt, which is the extra work that builds up when code is written quickly or poorly. By cleaning up the code regularly, teams can avoid bigger problems later. In short, refactoring keeps software healthy and makes life easier for everyone who works with it.
